replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

For situations like these it is often up to the moderator to determine what punishment to give out (to an extent). Zacd56 did the right thing in warning you, as abuse of the /report command is against the rules. Warns are minor infractions and nothing to worry about unless you continue to repeat the same offense.

Regards,
Mango_
